scoring_justification: Headline quantities are final aggregates from expensive MD simulations; the checker cannot re-run them, so we compare agent's reported values to paper gold with tolerances and structural ordering.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold formation energies (Table 1) and migration barriers/prefactors (Table 2) from the paper
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1 and Table 2 in the source PDF
hidden_assets.generation_method: Transcribed from the paper's reported values
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are reported in the paper; used as reference targets

outputs.description: Formation energies of six self-interstitial configurations in α‑Zr computed with the Ackland potential. Compared to the paper's reported values with a tolerance of ±0.1 eV.

Migration energy barriers and prefactors for the four jump mechanisms J1–J4 extracted from MD diffusion coefficients, together with the diffusional anisotropy factor p at 600 K. Em values compared to paper Table 2 with ±0.05 eV, Do prefactors within 50% relative, and p factor checked to lie within the experimental range [0.85, 0.95] or within 5% of the paper-derived reference.

output_contract.notes: Formation energies are compared against the paper's Table 1. Migration barriers are compared against the paper's Table 2; the anisotropy factor is checked for consistency with experimental values. All comparisons use result-level compare (T0) with appropriate tolerances and ordering checks.
